en: Jev is live: play against the real model in every game
Each visit is randomly assigned an opponent mode (Jev Hinted or Raw) and a move choice (Top pick or By odds); you can switch either at any time
Top pick: Jev always plays the move it rates highest. By odds: its move is drawn in proportion to its probabilities
Fairer comparison between Hinted and Raw mode
Jev's odds are hidden by default; tap the eye to reveal them
New Insights page with real, anonymous statistics, including whether Jev’s probabilities are calibrated (you can opt out)
Updates now load automatically, no hard refresh needed
About page: a short Methods section explains exactly how Jev plays
zh: Jev 正式上线：每个游戏都能和真实的模型对战
每次访问随机分配对手模式（Jev 提示 / 直觉）和出招方式（取最高 / 按概率），都可以随时切换
取最高：Jev 总是出概率最高的那一招；按概率：按它给出的概率按比例抽取出招
提示模式与直觉模式的对比更公平
Jev 的概率默认隐藏，点小眼睛即可查看
新增数据洞察页：真实的匿名统计，包括 Jev 的概率准不准（可选择不参与）
更新会自动加载，不再需要强制刷新
关于页新增“方法”部分，说明 Jev 具体是怎么出招的
